title: Next Greater Element I
statement: nums1 is a subset of nums2 and all values are distinct. For each value in nums1, find it in nums2 and report the first value to its right that is larger. Report -1 when there is none. Answer in the order nums1 gives.
constraints: all values across both arrays are distinct
every value of nums1 also appears in nums2
hints: Forget nums1 to begin with. Solve next-greater-to-the-right for every position of nums2 in one pass, then just look the answers up.
Scan nums2 and keep a stack of values still waiting for their answer. What must be true about that stack from bottom to top?
Keep it decreasing. A new value x resolves every stacked value smaller than x - pop them and record x as their answer - then push x. Store the answers in a Dictionary keyed by value.
